subQuests.subQuestName: Find the secret stashed in the Arcane Archive

711080301.text: "...Practicing the Light Piercer technique. Destroyed all the dummies by mistake... No money or resources... I've got an idea. I'll tie straws together to make my own..."

711080304.text: "...Practicing the Light Piercer technique. Destroyed all the dummies by mistake... I might as well train with the sword first."

711080307.text: "...Bored. As I sat before the courtyard, I felt slightly hungry... I pondered on what I saw the other day, and I suddenly felt enlightened. If I use the sword... (indiscernible) I'll call it Rain Cutter. I'll try it another day."

711080308.text: "...I accidentally fell while practicing Rain Cutter. Luckily, it's nothing serious... I thought of an idea. Why not dig a deep pond below the piles? Not only will it prevent injuries from falls, but I can raise fish for food..."

711080309.text: "...I went to a fisherman and bought dozens of fish... I tried cooking them. Their deliciousness was unrivaled..."

711080310.text: (The next ten or so pages are dedicated to detailed records of cooking methods for fish, and some are even paired with illustrations.)

711080401.text: "...Practicing the Light Piercer technique. Destroyed all the dummies by mistake... No money or resources... I've got an idea. I'll tie straws together to make my own..."

711080420.text: "...Look with the <color=#00E1FFFF>eyes</color>, and combine <color=#00E1FFFF>scrolls of knowledge from all places</color> with <color=#00E1FFFF>chambers of all corners</color>, then..."

711080421.text: (The next few pages are smudged and unintelligible. There is a comment from the 3rd Master at the side: This advises future generations to read extensively.)

711080407.text: "...Practicing the Light Piercer technique. Destroyed all the dummies by mistake... I might as well train with the sword first."

711082501.text: Sigh... To think that after a thousand years of heritage, the Guhua Clan's head doorkeeper must cheat others to survive... What shall we do, what can be done...

711082502.text: Ugh... Alright, come on now. Am I not sparing my junior from starving to death while guarding our gates...?

711082503.text: #And don't look at me like that. You're always depressed... But you were pleased to see {NICKNAME}'s performance just now, weren't you?

711082504.text: That fool from before? They get to take a look around for making you some rice with bacon? And I would be pleased about that? I would slap you to death if I were a few years younger...

711082505.text: Heh! Your technique was inferior to mine just a few years ago!

711082506.text: ...Anyway, listen... Only a few of us geezers are left. What do you plan to do after we stop testing those who may be destined to join us? Take those books with us to our graves?

711082508.text: Hah... Just forget it. What's the point of saying such depressing things?

711082509.text: Oh, why don't you try the food those kids made me? Hehe! I think it's better than Wanmin Restaurant's fare! Here, take a bite! Just a bite!

711089902.text: Also, the whole treasure thing still turned out to be a hoax in the end! Ugh, Paimon's really mad now! Just you wait, She's going to find something super valuable to take away from this place today!

711089903.text: Oh, there was also a line in that book just now that really bothered Paimon...

711089904.text: It said something along the lines of "Observe it with your <color=#00E1FFFF>eyes</color>." Could it be trying to say that we should use Elemental Sight?

711089906.text: #Did we... Did we actually find the Guhua Clan's treasure after all? {NICKNAME}, let's go take a look!
